categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the crystalline silicon solar cell production equipment industry, focusing on manufacturing and selling specialized equipment such as wet process equipment, vacuum equipment, intelligent manufacturing equipment, and photovoltaic cell equipment and process solutions. It also extends into semiconductor equipment and lithium battery new energy equipment sectors. The company provides turnkey solutions for various high-efficiency solar cell technologies including TOPCon, HJT, XBC, and perovskite solar cells.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including PECVD, LPCVD, MAD, RPD, PVD, and PAR for vacuum coating and thin film deposition. It integrates automated and intelligent manufacturing systems to enhance production efficiency and quality. The production methods emphasize modular design, customization based on customer needs, and integration of cutting-edge solar cell technologies such as TOPCon, HJT, XBC, and perovskite, with ongoing R&D in semiconductor wet process equipment and lithium battery vacuum coating.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major crystalline silicon solar cell manufacturers and semiconductor companies, primarily in the photovoltaic and semiconductor industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including emerging markets in Latin America, the Middle East, Japan, Singapore, and Malaysia. Its products are widely used by leading solar cell manufacturers and semiconductor device producers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant presence in the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta industrial regions. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to support overseas market expansion. Domestic sales account for over 90% of revenue, with growing international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, specializing in manufacturing production equipment for crystalline silicon solar cells. It also extends into upstream semiconductor equipment manufacturing and lithium battery equipment, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier and technology innovator within the solar cell and semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-efficiency solar cell equipment technologies such as TOPCon, HJT, XBC, and perovskite solar cells. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop low-cost, high-performance equipment and turnkey solutions, integrating automation and intelligent manufacturing. It is expanding into semiconductor wet process equipment and lithium battery vacuum coating, aiming to become a leading global provider of new energy and semiconductor equipment solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized solar cell production equipment and turnkey manufacturing solutions. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on signed sales contracts, providing installation, commissioning, and after-sales technical support. Additional income comes from government subsidies, investment income, and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer and supplier of crystalline silicon solar cell production equipment, recognized as a national manufacturing champion. It competes with other domestic and international photovoltaic equipment providers, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and expanding overseas presence to maintain and grow market share amid intensifying competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 18.89 billion, a 116.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.76 billion, up 69.18%. Total assets were RMB 33.63 billion with equity of RMB 11.09 billion. The company has demonstrated rapid growth driven by increased orders, technological innovation, and market expansion, maintaining strong profitability and cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, cost-effective, and technologically advanced solar cell production equipment tailored to multiple high-efficiency cell technologies. Its integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions enable customers to improve production efficiency and reduce costs. The company’s strong R&D, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to provide customized turnkey solutions differentiate it in the market, supported by robust after-sales service and a growing international footprint.
